objective: The problem analyst (package 18.2): 24 written problem descriptions (a dev set of 12 and a sealed set of 12) read by dclab_core's rules alone, by the rules with the analyst role (proposals checked against the person's words), and by a plain prompted model; every brief field scored right, wrong, missed or abstained. Gate analyst_gate_v1, fixed before any run: on the sealed set, more fields right with the analyst and none wrong that the rules left unknown.
rule: Scores say how these readers handle these descriptions, not how they handle any other text, and nothing about production readiness.
